approval: governor 2c3c3e39 pre-authorized a frozen-scope B-F7b hardening candidate; verifier d14789c6 asked for exact reviewed tenant-column/setting semantics and effective policies per role and command, keeping the populated positives and ACL/identity checks.

changes.note: The live pg_policies of a freshly provisioned schema for all 32 RLS tables, captured in the author run and pinned field for field: one PERMISSIVE policy per table for PUBLIC and command ALL. Its row condition compares the table's tenant column (or the alert payload tenant) to a per-request setting: app.tenant; app.education_tenant for pack_documents; app.release_tenant for release goal/link/material tables; app.alert_tenant for alerts. Project and clinical tables add namespace, workspace-owner and clinician conditions. The effective policy is identical for every runtime login and command; which commands a login may issue is fixed by the explicit privilege contract. reference_clinical_state_v1 reads are stricter than writes (removed sessions are hidden).

On a freshly provisioned schema, every RLS table has RLS enabled and forced; the live policies equal the pinned set exactly; every condition compares a row value to an app.* session setting, none is absent or unconditional; each write condition is contained in its read condition. No runtime login is superuser, has BYPASSRLS, or owns a table. Together with the forced-RLS and exact-privilege contract per login, a foreign row is not visible to or writable by any runtime login whatever the table holds.

not_included: Owner-seeded two-tenant rows for the 25 tables without lawful-flow population were not added (FK, append-only and writer-role triggers make generic seeding brittle); the populated positives remain the 7 tables named in 056.
